description: A collapsible app sidebar for navigation, with icon, off-canvas and mobile sheet modes.
overview:
`SidebarProvider` holds the open state and wraps the whole layout. Inside it, `Sidebar` renders the panel and `SidebarInset` renders the main content beside it. The sidebar stacks `SidebarHeader`, a scrolling `SidebarContent` and `SidebarFooter`. Content is organized into `SidebarGroup` sections, each with a `SidebarGroupLabel`, an optional `SidebarGroupAction` and a `SidebarGroupContent`. Navigation lives in a `SidebarMenu` of `SidebarMenuItem` rows, each holding a `SidebarMenuButton` and optionally a `SidebarMenuAction`, `SidebarMenuBadge` or nested `SidebarMenuSub`.

`SidebarTrigger` and `SidebarRail` toggle the sidebar. On screens narrower than `48rem`, the sidebar renders inside a `Sheet` instead. Use `Sidebar` for the main navigation of an app; for bottom navigation on small screens, consider `TabBar`.
usage:
Use `defaultOpen` on `SidebarProvider` for an uncontrolled sidebar, or `open` with `onOpenChange` to control it. Read and change state from any child with the `useSidebar` hook, which returns `state`, `open`, `setOpen`, `openMobile`, `setOpenMobile`, `isMobile` and `toggleSidebar`.

Set `collapsible="icon"` to shrink the sidebar to a rail of icons when collapsed, `offcanvas` to slide it out of view, or `none` to keep it fixed. Give each `SidebarMenuButton` a `tooltip` so its label stays available while collapsed to icons. Use the `render` prop on `SidebarMenuButton` to render it as a link.

examples.Floating: Uses the `floating` variant, a rounded panel with a shadow.
examples.Inset: Uses the `inset` variant, which also raises the main content into a rounded card.
examples.Collapsed: Starts collapsed to icons and expands from the rail.
examples.Offcanvas: Slides the sidebar fully out of view when collapsed.
examples.RightSide: Places the sidebar on the right edge.

parts.SidebarProvider: Holds the open state, provides it through context and wraps the layout.
parts.Sidebar: The sidebar panel; a sheet on mobile.
parts.SidebarTrigger: An icon button that toggles the sidebar.
parts.SidebarRail: A thin hit area along the sidebar's edge that toggles it on click.
parts.SidebarInset: The `main` element for page content next to the sidebar.
parts.SidebarInput: A compact `Input` styled for use in the sidebar.
parts.SidebarHeader: The top area, above the scrolling content.
parts.SidebarFooter: The bottom area, below the scrolling content.
parts.SidebarContent: The scrolling region that holds the groups.
parts.SidebarGroupLabel: The title of a group; it fades out when collapsed to icons.
parts.SidebarGroupAction: A small button in the corner of a group, such as an add button.
parts.SidebarMenuItem: A list item that holds a menu button and its extras.
parts.SidebarMenuButton: The clickable row for a destination or command.
parts.SidebarMenuAction: A small button at the end of a menu item, such as a more button.
parts.SidebarMenuBadge: A count or label shown at the end of a menu item.
parts.SidebarMenuSkeleton: A loading placeholder shaped like a menu item.
parts.SidebarMenuSub: A nested list of sub-items, indented with a leading line.
parts.SidebarMenuSubItem: A list item inside a sub-menu.
parts.SidebarMenuSubButton: The clickable row of a sub-item, rendered as a link by default.

SidebarProvider.defaultOpen: Sets whether the sidebar starts expanded when uncontrolled.
SidebarProvider.open: Controls whether the sidebar is expanded.
SidebarProvider.onOpenChange: Called with the new state when the sidebar expands or collapses.

Sidebar.side: Places the sidebar on the left or right edge.
Sidebar.variant: Chooses a full-height `sidebar`, a rounded `floating` panel, or an `inset` layout.
Sidebar.collapsible: Sets how the sidebar collapses: off canvas, to icons, or not at all.

SidebarMenuButton.isActive: Marks the button as the current item.
SidebarMenuButton.tooltip: Text or `TooltipContent` props for a tooltip shown only while collapsed on desktop.
SidebarMenuButton.variant: Uses a plain style or an `outline` style with a background and border.

SidebarMenuAction.showOnHover: On desktop, hides the action until its item is hovered or focused.

SidebarMenuSkeleton.showIcon: Adds a square placeholder for an icon.

SidebarMenuSubButton.isActive: Marks the sub-item as the current page.

accessibility:
- `SidebarTrigger` and `SidebarRail` are labelled `Toggle Sidebar`. The rail is removed from the tab order, so keep a `SidebarTrigger` in reach of keyboard users.
- Press `Command-B` on Apple platforms, or `Ctrl+B` elsewhere, to toggle the sidebar.
- On mobile, the sidebar is a dialog with a visually hidden title, `Sidebar`; `Escape` closes it.
- Menu-button tooltips appear only while the sidebar is collapsed, so labels stay available when only icons show.
notes:
- Every toggle writes the state to a `sidebar_state` cookie for 7 days. Read it on the server to set `defaultOpen` and avoid a flash on load.
- Widths come from `--sidebar-width` (`16rem`) and `--sidebar-width-icon` (`3rem`), set on `SidebarProvider`; override them through its `style`.
- The sidebar element exposes `data-state` (`expanded` or `collapsed`), `data-collapsible`, `data-variant` and `data-side` for styling. Menu buttons set `data-active` and `data-size`.
- `useSidebar` throws if it's used outside a `SidebarProvider`.
- The panel uses `bg-surface-secondary`; active items use `bg-item-selected` with a `text-link` icon.
